roadmap.principle: Codex windows have no persistent memory. Complex projects require external memory to survive session boundaries. File-based state is the MVP approach.

components.content: Current stage, completed stages, active agent, last action timestamp, mode in use
components.purpose: Single source of truth for build progress

components.content: Page tree, API endpoints, DB tables, permission model, tech stack
Original requirements, derived requirements, traceability to implementation
Task nodes with status (pending/in_progress/complete), dependencies, file ownership
Key decisions with rationale, date, and context
components.purpose: Why was this choice made? Avoid re-deciding.

components.content: Condensed state for new Codex window: what was done, what remains, how to continue
components.purpose: One file to resume the project

phases.retrievalScript: scripts/factory-state-retrieve.ps1 — reads all state files and outputs a summary for the new Codex window
phases.startupCheck: New Codex window reads handoff-packet.md first, then state.json, then continues from last active stage

components: Agent performance metrics per project type
Shared knowledge base across Codex Factory users
Learned patterns from past complex projects

continuationProtocol.startup: 1. Read .codex-factory/handoff-packet.md 2. Read .codex-factory/state.json 3. Resume at current stage
continuationProtocol.midSession: After each stage completion, update state.json and append to decisions.md
continuationProtocol.handoff: Before session end, generate fresh handoff-packet.md with current state summary
continuationProtocol.verification: Startup verification confirms state files exist and are consistent
